title: A recovered claim whose newly named root is at newer content records no source sighting, so checks there are stale against the run's old latest source change
outcome:
Observed 2026-10-02 on w-72e7daa92a6a, while closing an already-fixed item with evidence.

Setup:
- The item's fix had landed as 5eb447a. Under the earlier claim (Termal::Opus2, root .tmp/wt-p0), the run's latest source change was recorded at run-feed position 37: revision content-v1:1316e9e82cc2c2f279ba4c56472572d85d5b55bf6e32ddf4a75b86839195c5b7, with check 968a444c passing there.
- Termal::Opus3 recovered the lapsed claim, named a new root .tmp/wt-p0-close-9474 clean at master 169fc8b (content-v1:5e75553035e4697dd433ec724c1eeff929df49b4c655ff380c08c9236cb979c4), made no edits, ran the focused test there (verification c0e143d4, passed) and a credited full gate (test-03c1630f, passed). The independent evaluation, delegation-3dbaaaaf, passed 4 of 4.

`done` was then refused: "criterion 1 requires test verification, and the newest one (c0e143d41def44ee85bf4c953306dc4c) does not verify the run's latest source change (stale_source_revision); record a passing check of the current source, or drop the binding". Its details: decider latest_change, position 37, revision 1316e9e8 in workspace .tmp/wt-p0; the check revision was 5e75553 in .tmp/wt-p0-close-9474; satisfied_by 968a444c, superseded because a newer verification exists.

Cause: naming a new root at different content, with no edits, records no source sighting. The run's latest source change stays at the old workspace's revision, and the newest check, being at newer content, counts as stale. An item already fixed on master cannot be closed by checking it on current master.

Workaround used: a new worktree at the old revision (5eb447a, verified to hash to 1316e9e8), renamed as the root, with the check run there.

Fix options, for the host or Engram to decide:
- the host records a source sighting when a root is named or renamed;
- or Engram treats a root rename's sealed or new revision as the run's latest source.
acceptance: After a claim names a new root at different content with no edits, a passing bound check there satisfies the criterion at done (no stale_source_revision); a test covers the rename-without-edit case.
The full five-stage gate passes on the reviewed tree, and the review pair has no outstanding Medium or higher.
